title: Unify i18n service registration across server/dev/mock environments
body:
i18n API returns 404/501 in server mode because no i18n service is registered on the kernel. MSW mock mode works but bypasses the kernel entirely via hand-written custom handlers, with duplicated `loadAppLocale()` in both `browser.ts` and `server.ts`.

### Shared handler module (`i18nHandlers.ts`)

Single source of truth for locale loading and handler creation, mirroring the existing `createAuthHandlers` pattern:

```ts
import { createI18nHandlers, createI18nService } from './i18nHandlers';

// MSW mode — handler factory
customHandlers: [...createI18nHandlers('/api/v1')]

// Kernel service registration
kernel.registerService('i18n', createI18nService());
```

### Kernel service registration (`createKernel.ts`)

- Register `i18n` service via `kernel.registerService('i18n', ...)` alongside existing `analytics` service
- Add `i18n.getTranslations` routing to the broker shim so the dispatcher can serve requests through the kernel mechanism

### Server mode plugin (`i18nPlugin.ts`)

- `I18nPlugin` class registers the i18n service during kernel bootstrap via `start(ctx)`
- Added to `objectstack.config.ts` and `examples/crm/server.ts`

### Cleanup

- Removed duplicate `loadAppLocale()` from `browser.ts` and `server.ts`
- Both now delegate to shared `createI18nHandlers()`

### Tests

- 11 tests covering `loadAppLocale`, `createI18nService`, and `createI18nHandlers` (unit + MSW integration)

> *This section details on the original issue you should resolve*
> 
> <issue_title>i18n REST API/前端 mock 行为不一致问题评估</issue_title>
> <issue_description>### 背景
> ObjectUI 项目存在如下 i18n 相关核心问题：
> 
> 1. pnpm dev（后台服务端模式）下 i18n 接口直报 404/501，原因是 i18n 服务未注册。
> 2. pnpm msw:dev（前端 MSW mock）模式下接口总是可用，因为 MSW 手写了 handler，并绕开内核机制。
> 3. REST/Server 端与 MSW/前端 mock 数据加载路径完全不同，导致同一个前端组件实际收到不同数据结构。
> 4. i18n 翻译数据来源不统一，服务端依赖本地文件，mock 环境依赖 example locales 导入。
> 5. 应该使用 objectstack 提供的服务端 i18n 而不是本地加载。
> 
> ### 建议
> - server/dev/mock 三种环境下统一 i18n 服务注册与数据加载策略。
> </issue_description>
